regole.partita: Match: correct winner 3 points (more if few people picked it, fewer if it was the favourite). If the winner is right: +2 for the exact set score, +3 for the exact total games or +1 if you are off by 2 games at most.
regole.torneo: Tournament: winner 10 points, runner-up 5, also weighted by how many picked them (from half to two and a half times).
regole.blocco: Predictions close when the match or tournament starts. Vote percentages are shown only after closing.

privacy.testo: BeachPick stores only the data the game needs: email (to sign in), nickname, country, language, your predictions, leagues and the days you use the app (to count active users). We don't sell or share data and we don't use profiling cookies: only technical cookies for sign-in and language. You can delete your account and all your data at any time from your profile.
